definitions.full: H109. adab [ אָדַב ] verb grieve ; Hiph`il Infinitive לַאֲדִיב (= לְהַאֲדִיב Ges § 53 . 3. R, 7) to cause to grieve 1Sam 2:33 . (But Dr proposes לְהָדִיב from דוב q. v.)
